output.reason: [ev-f1b3fbffbb2a] says that delayed refresh requests were stored as `<appKey>/<compareWith>`, but the address of compareWith was stored instead of its value. As a result, the controller used invalid refresh levels. The fix makes it use the correct value. [ev-912972ca011e] and [ev-6a5770f3e2a7] show the visible symptom: logs showed absurd comparison levels instead of 0–3. Nothing fails, gets rejected or has to be migrated, so a low-severity behavior-change (refreshes now use the correct compareWith level) fits better than a failure kind.
